periods.time: Delayed final day and aftermath of the 62nd Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival
periods.label: 第六十二届七星剑王
periods.species: human Blazer; newly awakened fate-transcending existence / Desperado-class potential

status.current: defeats Stella in the Seven Stars final and receives the championship title
status.condition: survives cardiac arrest, exhausts Ittou Shura, then breaks through his fixed magic limit by force of will and love

relationships.stella-vermillion: Fiancee, lover and strongest rival; he refuses to let anyone else become her strongest and consummates their relationship after the final.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Younger sister; she worries through the final and later rages after discovering his night with Stella.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Friend who helps tune him before the final and guards him afterward.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Former opponent who pushes him to enter the final with absolute confidence.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Elder brother who tests whether his weak sword can face a dragon.

periods.summary: Ikki wakes from near death just in time for the delayed championship. Afraid of Stella's awakened dragon power, he requests a gauntlet of strong sparring partners and converts fear into peak readiness. In the final he first suppresses Stella with prediction, Madoka and close-range pressure, but Dragon Spirit and the lava field force him into a soul clash. He exhausts Ittou Shura and seems to lose to Stella's finishing blow, yet rejects a respectable defeat inside a vision of fate's chains. His love for Stella and desire to remain her strongest break those chains, raising his magic beyond its fixed limit. He returns at nine, uses Ittou Rasetsu and the final secret sword Oikage to defeat Stella, becomes Seven Stars Sword King, and later stands beside her on the podium after their relationship deepens in the infirmary.

key_events.summary: Uses allies and rivals to sharpen his body and confidence before facing Stella.
Breaks fate's chains, awakens new magic, creates Oikage, and wins the final.
Confesses his possessive love for Stella and becomes her lover physically.
Receives the Seven Stars Sword King title and raises Hagun's flag.
